task: Eligibility for direct comparison of two explicitly caller-selected assessment/result pairs with selected scale levels
focus: Caller supplies request,left assessment,left result,right assessment,right result as five named IRIs; raw graph cannot supply the four reserved selector predicates

supplemental_fields.levelScaleVersion: Declared scale-version membership of a level resource; not a new native relation
supplemental_fields.basisVersion: Declared ArtifactVersion of the selected native assessment basis
supplemental_fields.temporalContext: Opaque identity of the declared relevant temporal interpretation context; not a timestamp or interval algorithm
supplemental_fields.source: Provenance IRI for each assessment declaration; presence is not truth

identity: Asserted named sameAs normalized; different IRIs without differentFrom are unresolved; equal labels/numeric codes never establish identity or comparability; identity conflict rejects
required_comparison: usesMethod R-46 and usesMethodVersion RX-015 with matching versionOf target
hasBasis R-12 with supplementary basisVersion and matching target
assessmentContext R-45 and usesContextVersion RX-014 with matching target
Explicit permitsScale R-49 and specifiesDimension RK2-018 for the selected result
priority: Malformed/type/count errors -> INVALID; known selection or version-binding mismatch -> INVALID_SELECTION; known cross-side policy mismatch -> NOT_COMPARABLE; missing or unresolved evidence -> NOT_READY; otherwise admissible under this strict policy
limits: No numeric ordering/ranking or score calculation
No formula or reported-score reproducibility claim
No source truth or independent validation
ledger: Source-bound alternative-route supplement; historical HermiT and SHACL NOT_RUN rows remain immutable and visible; no relabeling of engine outcomes
